description: Family Bank Limited is a licensed commercial bank in Kenya founded in 1984 as Family Finance Building Society Ltd. Since then, it has grown into one of the country's leading financial institutions, serving over 1.3 million customers through a network of 96 branches across 32 counties, supported by over 5,000 banking agents and 103,000 merchants nationwide. Since its conversion into a commercial bank in 2007, the Bank has remained committed to advancing financial inclusion by providing accessible and affordable financial solutions, particularly to retail customers and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. Family Bank has three wholly owned subsidiaries: (1) Family Bank Insurance Agency, a licensed insurance intermediary that provides a wide range of insurance solutions, including life, medical, motor, property, and business-related insurance products to customers across Kenya. (2) Family Group Foundation, the corporate social investment arm of the bank focused on education, entrepreneurship, financial inclusion, environmental sustainability, and community empowerment. (3) Pesapap Digital, a technology company that develops digital products to support the group's innovation strategy and digital financial services.
